what: The machine-readable half of the code immutability policy (policies/code-immutability.md): what .claude/hooks/code_immutability.py and .githooks/pre-commit enforce. The two halves are one policy; tests/test_policy.py holds them to each other.
name: code-immutability

protected.description: A published release folder: a directory at vMAJOR/vMAJOR.MINOR/vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH/ that holds a manifest.json. Everything under it, the manifest included.

self.description: The files that make up this behaviour policy and its enforcement. An agent may not weaken its own controls quietly (riskmandate.ai RM-R0015, change its own permissions): a write to any of them asks the person.

shell.description: A shell command is refused when one of its writes lands in a protected folder: an argument of a verb that changes every path it names, the destination of a verb that writes only its last path, the target of a > or >> redirect, or a protected path named in an inline script that writes files. Reading a protected folder is never refused.

instructions: Code in a published release folder (vX/vX.Y/vX.Y.Z/) is immutable: never edit, move, rename, overwrite or delete a file there, for any reason, including a typo or a comment. To change the kit: python3 tools/release.py bump patch (or minor), edit src/, python3 tools/release.py cut, then add the line to site/data/versions.json and rebuild. A new major starts from the last good release: python3 tools/release.py major --from vX.Y.Z. If you believe a published file must change (a leaked secret, a legal takedown), stop and ask the person; only a person may do it, outside the agent, and it is recorded in BRIEF-CORRECTIONS.md.
